notes: Six current policies reject a vacuous invocation

guarantee: Every selected span connects to its test root
notes: Missing parent and second root and self-cycle are separate inputs

guarantee: Alternative parents cannot hide a cycle
notes: Both observation orders checked; acyclic alternatives stay valid

guarantee: Parent identity is scoped to its trace
notes: A span in another trace cannot complete ancestry

guarantee: Span identity is trace ID plus span ID
notes: Both trace views are published from one capture
Value-equal received records remain separate observations

guarantee: Repeated views do not invent exports
notes: Receiver snapshots reuse the same record instance for an already observed span

guarantee: Opt-in instrumentation check detects wrapping the same operation
notes: This policy is an explicit test assertion; it is not a product deduplication algorithm

guarantee: Selected header and metadata keys are present without extras
notes: Values remain assertions of the consuming test

guarantee: Selected trace errors retain status and exception details
notes: Other traces' span status is outside this policy

guarantee: Export evidence includes rejection and receiver warnings
Attribute type and deprecation follow generated SemConv
notes: Weaver owns semantics; unknown custom keys are allowed; no separate SDK registry

guarantee: Policy failures attach evidence without replacing original test failure
notes: Original exception identity is an explicit contract
Real OTLP to DuckDB to generated tool behavior replaces old SDK and HTTP contracts; not migrated by test-count matching
